_doc: Risky Rails economy model for econ.py. {v, canon} = checked against rr-bible on every run; {v, assumed} = no canon yet, printed in every report. Replace assumed values with live numbers from dash.py (economy export: average fare_bank per run, sinks per run) as soon as they exist. Model: references/economy-model.md.

installs_per_day.assumed: soft-launch scale; only changes totals, not per-player pacing

play_prob_retained.assumed: share of still-engaged players who play on a given day

runs_day0_mean.assumed: first session length; canon asks >= 10 min (one run + results)

runs_later_mean.assumed: runs per active day after day 0

engaged_runs_per_day.assumed: pacing cohort: plays every day until the hour limit

fare_full.assumed: fare banked by an arriving crew member; calibrated by sweep so loco 2 lands in about 2 runs (gameplay.progress.first_unlock)

p_arrive.assumed: arrival chance; overall completion is checked against release.kpi.completion

kit.assumed: supplies ordered per train per run (one Depotron order at a time, gameplay.supplies.one_order)

fare_full.assumed: +25% per step like the trip miles (gameplay.difficulty.trip_miles)
up to x3.0 fork multipliers on Insane (gameplay.fork.risky)

fare_cv.assumed: run-to-run spread from forks, mood and crew

failed_trip.question: OQ-011
failed_trip._options: A pays the banked fare, B pays nothing, C pays banked minus penalty

banked_share.assumed: share of the run's fare already banked at stations when it fails

fare_split.assumed: each crew member banks the full crew fare (no canon; proposed open question)

kit_paid.assumed: the kit is per train; whoever orders pays, so each player pays kit / crew_mean on average ('each' = every player pays the whole kit)

crew_mean.assumed: mean crew size (up to 6 per train); replace with live crew counts from the run_end crew field

start_coins.assumed: no canon; the petty-cash float is superseded (economy.currency.float)

short_penalty.assumed: arrival chance multiplier when a player could not afford the run's kit

price.assumed: set for about 2 h after loco 2 (gameplay.progress.pacing)

p_double_fare.assumed: a would-be payer buys Double Fare when shown

p_pack.assumed: a would-be payer buys a pack when shown while short

p_organic_daily.assumed: a would-be payer buys Double Fare unprompted (shop, store page) on an active day
